concerns.text: The plan defines `exposure_level` as “proportion of comments from target subreddits” (task 4) and `self_eval_score` as “sentiment‑adjusted first‑person pronoun ratio” (task 8). Both metrics are computed from the same Reddit comment stream belonging to the user. This violates Constitution Principle VI (Distinct Data Stream Integrity) because the predictor (`exposure_level`) is not derived from an independent exposure stream but from the user’s own comments, which also generate the outcome (`self_eval_score`). Consequently the validation of moderation effects is circular: the predictor is partially a summary of the outcome data, making any regression result tautological rather than an independent test of a psychological mechanism.
